payload.description: Any record of the policy being used in an individual licensing decision. The draft policy says that where people object to an application, it has to be decided at a hearing of the council's Licensing sub-committee, and the council's premises licence page invites the public to comment on applications. We have not gathered any of those hearing records, so we cannot yet show the policy being applied case by case.
